title: Project scaffolding and Vitest setup
scope: Initialize Vite + React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS and configure Vitest.

title: CheapShark API client and unit tests
scope: Implement src/services/cheapshark.ts and corresponding mock tests.

title: Backlog calculation engine and planner tests
scope: Implement src/services/planner.ts and unit tests for time distribution.

title: LocalStorage state manager and persistence tests
scope: Implement src/services/storage.ts with JSON import/export and error handling.

title: UI components and dashboard integration
scope: Build BacklogManager, RoadmapTimeline, and DealRadar views.

title: CI/CD pipeline and GitHub Pages configuration
scope: Set base path in vite.config.ts, create .github/workflows/deploy.yml, verify local build artifact path, and push CI configuration.

title: Duration prompt modal and Codex inspector
scope: Implement DurationPromptModal shown before every backlog add (manual entry in BacklogManager and '+ Backlog' in DealRadar), prefilled from known playtime data with a 20h fallback. Implement GameCodex left-sidebar search component querying CheapShark for game metadata (release date, reviews, publisher/synopsis) with debounced input, loading/empty/error states, and an add-to-backlog affordance routed through the duration modal.

title: 3-column dashboard layout and retro ad sidebar
scope: Restructure the main view into a responsive CSS Grid 3-column dashboard: GameCodex (left), existing center views (BacklogManager, RoadmapTimeline, DealRadar), RetroAdsSidebar (right). Sidebars collapse to drawers under 1280px and the layout stacks single-column under 768px without layout shift. Build RetroAdsSidebar with 90s-style retro banners, sponsor cards, and affiliate deal highlights (rel="sponsored noopener"), fully styled for light and dark mode.
